findings: The print says the duodenal enterokinase 'activates trypsinogen into trypsin, which digests proteins into polypeptides'; kept as printed.
The print gives the ileum as 'the last three fifth i.e., about 3.5 metres' and the jejunum as 2.4 metres; kept as printed.
Printed 'cecum' and 'caecum' both appear; the lesson uses cecum.
